description: Angular component 'PropertyGroupsComponent' for displaying detailed property groups of a 'Layer' object, including visibility, geometry, buffer, hierarchy, effects, and input information.

classes.name: PropertyGroupsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for rendering property groups of a Layer object, including methods for processing layer data and generating summaries.

methods.name: hasInputChannel
methods.description: Checks if the Layer has an input window info channel.

methods.name: getDestinationFrame
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the destination frame coordinates if available.

methods.name: hasIgnoreDestinationFrame
methods.description: Determines if the layer has the ignore destination frame flag set.

methods.name: formatFloat
methods.description: Rounds a number to two decimal places.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Generates a summary array of visibility and occlusion reasons for the layer.
